title: Rectangular section
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, initiate a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this first face, draw a closed loop composed of four straight lines. The first line starts at the origin and extends horizontally to a point 0.0239 meters. The second line begins from this endpoint and moves vertically upwards to a height of 0.0559 meters. The third line continues from this point, moving horizontally back to the vertical axis. Finally, the fourth line completes the loop by connecting back to the origin. After drawing the loop, apply a scaling factor of 0.0559 to the entire sketch. Transform the two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by applying the same Euler angles and translation vector used initially. Proceed to extrude the sketch along its normal direction to a depth of 0.75 meters, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Integrate the extruded shape into a new solid body. The dimensions of this rectangular section are 0.0239 meters in length, 0.0559 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0239, 0).lineTo(0.0239, 0.0559).lineTo(0, 0.0559).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0239, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0239, 0.0559) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0559) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular section
r = r.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions from the bounding box
x_dim = 0.0239
y_dim = 0.0559
z_dim = 0.7500

# The part is a simple rectangular prism (slender bar) standing along Z.
# FRONT view (looking along +Y): width = X, height = Z
# RIGHT view (looking along -X): width = Y, height = Z
# TOP view (looking down): X by Y rectangle

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(x_dim, y_dim, z_dim, centered=(True, True, False))
)

import cadquery as cq

# The part is a plain rectangular bar (thin tall prism)
# X = 0.0239, Y = 0.0559, Z = 0.7500

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(0.0239, 0.0559)   # X x Y cross-section
    .extrude(0.75)          # height along Z
)
